# Ashmita Vinyls

> Premier PVC vinyl products manufacturer and supplier based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Ashmita Vinyls specializes in manufacturing and distributing industrial PVC strip curtains, polar freezer curtains, anti-insect amber yellow strip rolls, phthalate-free DOTP vinyl strips, welding screen curtains, and stainless steel (SS304/SS202) mounting hardware for warehouses, cold chains, pharmaceutical cleanrooms, and food processing facilities across India.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://ashmitavinyls.com/): Leading PVC vinyl products manufacturer, industrial curtains, and custom commercial solutions.
- [About Us](https://ashmitavinyls.com/about): Our manufacturing heritage, quality control standards, and industrial capabilities.
- [Products](https://ashmitavinyls.com/product): Comprehensive catalog of transparent standard PVC rolls, polar grade vinyl, ribbed curtains, opaque strips, and mounting brackets.
- [Applications & Industries](https://ashmitavinyls.com/supplier): Sector-specific PVC curtain solutions for warehousing, logistics, cold storage, food processing, and manufacturing plants.
- [News & Blog](https://ashmitavinyls.com/blog): Technical buying guides, thermal efficiency studies, maintenance routines, and PVC industry trends.
- [Connect / Contact](https://ashmitavinyls.com/connect): Get in touch for B2B wholesale pricing, custom dimension orders, and technical specifications.

## Product Categories Breakdown

- [PVC Strip Curtain Rolls](https://ashmitavinyls.com/product): Standard transparent, transparent supreme, and crystal clear vinyl rolls (2mm, 3mm, 5mm thickness in 8" and 12" widths).
- [Polar Freezer Grade Rolls](https://ashmitavinyls.com/product): Sub-zero flexible PVC strip curtains engineered for blast freezers and cold rooms operating down to -40°C.
- [Anti-Insect Amber PVC Rolls](https://ashmitavinyls.com/product): Yellow wavelength optical repellent and citronella infused strip curtains for food processing and hygiene zones.
- [Phthalate-Free (DOTP) PVC Rolls](https://ashmitavinyls.com/product): Safe, eco-compliant, non-toxic vinyl curtains for pharmaceutical and food-grade cleanrooms.
- [Mounting Brackets & Tracks](https://ashmitavinyls.com/product): Stainless steel SS304, SS202 hook-on hanging tracks, clamp sets, and magnetic curtain hardware.
